verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source acquisition verification. Preserve source conflicts and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: S.S. Deadly Bomber — Ki Blast Ultimate.

verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 reference material identifies S.S. Deadly Bomber as a Ki Blast Ultimate with a tracking projectile, 15-hit characteristic, knockback, and 400 Ki cost.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: Current reference material lists Parallel Quest 115 — Extreme Battle with Android 13!. Independent sources document the skill as a reward associated with Android 13 after the Ultimate Finish, while community reports also consistently describe the remaining drop as RNG.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as true because independent documentation explicitly describes S.S. Deadly Bomber as an Ultimate Finish reward from PQ115; the record does not infer the requirement merely from the skill being an Ultimate.
verification_audit.variant_policy: S.S. Deadly Bomber is kept distinct from Shocking Death Ball, Death Ball, Super Vanishing Ball, and other Android 13 techniques.
verification_audit.damage_policy: The current reference reports 15 hits and approximately 30% damage, but exact damage is not promoted as a canonical database value because version stability is not established.

records.name: S.S. Deadly Bomber
records.character_source: Android 13 and Super Baby 2 customizable partner documented by current references
records.unlock_method: Parallel Quest 115 — Extreme Battle with Android 13! — Ultimate Finish reward
records.skill_description: Fire a powerful red Ki Blast sphere that homes in on the opponent after launch.
records.mechanics_notes: The user creates and launches a large red Ki sphere. Unlike a straight projectile, it tracks the locked-on opponent by repeatedly adjusting its path and detonates on contact or after its tracking sequence ends. Current reference material classifies it as a projectile, ball, tracking, long-range, 15-hit and knockback Ultimate.
